Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.port.inbound

Interface MonitorClinicalTrialsUseCase

All Known Implementing Classes:
ClinicalTrialService
public interface MonitorClinicalTrialsUseCase
Inbound port for the clinical trial monitoring use case.

Provides operations to retrieve clinical trials for display and to trigger an on-demand harvest cycle from ClinicalTrials.gov. The implementation delegates to ClinicalTrialPort for persistence and ClinicalTrialHarvestingPort for discovery.
